behavior: The landing hero and checkout section use the Codex-generated images, with the river marks on the painted water
acceptance: Given /, when it loads, then the hero background and the checkout section background are the generated images served through next/image (AVIF or WebP), and every file is recorded in docs/images.md

Given widths 360 and 390, then all four river marks are visible and none overlaps the email field, the hero note or the invoice panel; given 1440, the four marks sit on the painted river (manual: design review)
Given a production build, when Lighthouse runs on / (mobile preset), then Performance >= 90, Accessibility >= 95 and LCP < 2.5 s
notes: 2026-10-08 review pass by subagent: Pass. Code: hero-journey.tsx and checkout-preview.tsx render HERO_IMAGE/CHECKOUT_IMAGE (constants/landing-images.ts) via next/image (hero priority, sizes=100vw); river.ts coords are in 1672x941 image space matching the webp; smoothPath (lib/art.ts) is Catmull-Rom to cubic, covered by test/art.test.ts; cubicPoint/RIVER_PATH fully removed. DawnLandscape/DuskLandscape stay in use by components/directions/*-comp.tsx, so not dead. grep candidates in apps/web/src: only hero-c (directions.ts:31), which still exists on disk; docs/images.md rows match hero-dawn.webp and checkout-dusk.webp; check-images: 3 images, all recorded. Screens (taken 17:32, after last source edit): at 1440 all four marks on painted water (zoomed crop), line crosses only water between marks; at 768/390/360 compact marks on water, mark 4 sits at the left-bank edge but sampled image pixels around (830,748) are bright water (mean rgb 237,229,213); no mark overlaps form, note or panel; tx line fits one line at 360. Contrast measured from pixels: hero headline ~10.9:1, subhead 6.0-6.5:1, note worst-case bg at 1440 5.5:1; checkout h1 at 360 over the sun ~4.0:1 at p90 bg (large text, >3:1), subhead 7.5:1+. Checkout image crops well at 1440/768/360, no overflow. Ran: playwright landing+a11y+kit+smoke 27 passed; vitest 15 passed; check-images exit 0; Lighthouse log perf 99, a11y 100, LCP 1714 ms. Minor, non-blocking: the drawn line zigzags bank to bank rather than following the river centerline; reads as a route, acceptable.
